title: PR body describes the new terminal_types golden as built on 'fixture', but the demo runs 'fixture off' with explicit spawn_node directives
evidence:
PR body (committed at _bmad-output/pr-bodies/5.11.md:35): "New `demos/terminal_types.dem` (era 3, growth on, fixture + one small_biz + one campus): captures at 5000 ms and 30000 ms…" — actual demos/terminal_types.dem directives: "fixture off
growth on
spawn_node router_mid 20 15
spawn_node residential 8 15
spawn_node content_host 32 15
spawn_node residential 14 22
spawn_node residential 26 22
spawn_node small_biz 12 10
spawn_node campus 30 10"
detail: In this harness's vocabulary 'fixture' is a literal directive (e.g. node_health.dem 'fixture qos'); the golden is actually constructed via explicit spawn_node layout. Cause documentation mischaracterizes the new golden's construction mechanism.
recommended_fix: Amend the PR body to read 'fixture off + explicit spawn_node layout (router, 3 homes, host, small_biz, campus)' instead of 'fixture + one small_biz + one campus'.
